criterion: Rule-in A: higher-risk stratum (age <6 mo, or non-frontal hematoma >3 cm, or ≥2 findings)
Rule-in B: higher-risk stratum, or seizure, or ≥3 vomiting episodes
Rule-in E: age <12 mo, or non-frontal hematoma, or vomiting, or seizure, or LOC ≥5 s
Observation-eligible 1: age ≥12 mo, single finding, no non-frontal hematoma >3 cm (lower-risk stratum)
Observation-eligible 2: asymptomatic (no vomiting, seizure, LOC ≥5 s, acting normally), age ≥12 mo, no non-frontal hematoma >3 cm
Observation-eligible 3: asymptomatic, age ≥6 mo, no non-frontal hematoma
